assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmic triggers and assess stroke risk.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was performed with CPT 93229.
The diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I47.1 support the clinical justification.
The required precertification was not obtained, with denial code CO-197.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197, indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The claim cannot be processed for payment at this time.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
